_about: What changed at each practice run that set a new best (>5% over the previous best), read from the agent's own edits to solution.py and its notes in the Hermes session log. Keys are attempt numbers (1-based). Steps where the edit was not captured in the log are left unlabelled.

deepseek-v4.1-flash/fp8.3: zero-pad odd K=4127 so loads vectorize

deepseek-v4.1-flash/kda.6: split sequential state pass from parallel output pass

deepseek-v4.1-flash/paged.1: split-K flash-decode, one program per GQA group
deepseek-v4.1-flash/paged.2: CUDA-graph replay to hide launch cost

deepseek-v4.1-flash/topk.3: template on M: keep list in registers

deepseek-v4.1-flash/moe.1: grouped GEMM + fused SwiGLU, on-device schedule
deepseek-v4.1-flash/moe.3: TMA loads, kept only if output matches

qwen3.8-max/fp8.3: fp8 GEMM + split-K path for skinny M

qwen3.8-max/paged.3: fuse merge into one kernel (last-CTA) + CUDA graph

qwen3.8-max/topk.5: max-extraction instead of full sort, cached launcher

qwen3.8-max/moe.1: grouped GEMM + fused SwiGLU, device tile map

kimi-k3/fp8.2: zero-pad odd K + wider K tiles

kimi-k3/kda.3: doubling inverse, cached buffers, double-buffered loads

kimi-k3/topk.2: CUDA warp bitonic sort + tree merge

kimi-k3/moe.1: grouped GEMM + fused SwiGLU, sync-free schedule

gpt-6.1/fp8.3: pad odd K with a Triton copy kernel

gpt-6.1/paged.1: split-K decode, one program per head
gpt-6.1/paged.2: one program per KV head, tl.dot over GQA group

gpt-6.1/moe.2: grouped tile order for L2 reuse

gpt-6.1/w4a16.3: one scale/zero load per group, smaller N tiles

glm-5.3/kda.5: fused w/z dots + safe fallback kernel

glm-5.3/paged.1: split-K flash-decode for each GQA group

glm-5.3/moe.6: gate/up interleaved: one dot, one accumulator
